purpose: Contract for ingesting and using external blogs, videos, podcasts and case material.
rules: External content is enrichment, not a replacement for deterministic mechanics.
P0 deterministic output always outranks external claims about chart calculation.
P1 lineage material can explain Human Design concepts but cannot change computed chart facts.
P2 practitioner material may provide interpretation, application, examples and alternative framing.
P3 community material is experiential evidence only and must be labelled as such.
P4 critical material may surface uncertainty, disagreement or limitations but cannot rewrite Human Design mechanics.
Every external claim must retain source_id, locator and claim_type.
Every external claim must record whether it is supported, disputed, experiential, interpretive or critical.
Conflicting external claims must be stored as a conflict set rather than silently merged.
Multiple sources that repeat the same wording or claim do not count as independent corroboration without provenance review.
External claims must never be promoted into deterministic evidence records.
The AI may use external material only when the question calls for interpretation, practical examples, alternative perspectives or critical context.
A source can be useful even when its claim is not accepted as authoritative; usefulness and truth authority are separate dimensions.
Copyrighted material must be represented by metadata, concise paraphrase and provenance unless rights explicitly permit fuller use.
Video and podcast ingestion should prefer creator-provided transcripts or authorized captions and store segment locators rather than reproducing full transcripts.

Records sharing conflict_group remain separate; the packet exposes distinct claims as conflict_sets requiring review, and the AI must disclose disagreement rather than silently merge or choose a winner.
